description: Source-backed formats with companion context and parseable key/JWT controls. Unsupported formats remain visible.

title: Detection accuracy
description: Exact secret detection across identical, synthetic files.

title: GitHub token contexts
description: One never-issued, credential-shaped token across four text contexts and two negative controls.

title: Credential formats
description: Nine synthetic credential shapes, three deterministic samples per shape.

title: Context & boundaries
description: Quoting, encoding, line endings, multiple spans, and long-input detection.

title: Negative controls
description: Benign identifiers, placeholders, incomplete shapes, and ordinary text.

title: SendGrid regressions
description: SendGrid shapes across ten contexts, with URL-safe punctuation and near-miss controls.

title: Reference syntax
description: Code expressions, interpolation, and secret-manager references with paired literal-secret controls.

title: Beta.3 regressions
description: Closed milestone-6 regression expectations, measured against the installed published scanners.

title: Detector coverage
description: Synthetic positive shapes, prefix variants, and negative controls for every registered beta.3 detector.

title: Untargeted real-world shapes
description: Real-world-shaped synthetic config, logs, lockfiles, source and docs, authored locally rather than ingested — this measures a global false-alarm rate, not any family's evidence, and moves no family's support status. A flag here is discovery evidence; never relabel the fixture, add a detector exception, or edit it to make it quiet.

title: Beta.8 low-coverage hardening (#207)
description: Positives, context twins, value twins and benign controls that raise twelve low-coverage registry families (supabase, atlassian, firebase, sentry org and user, telegram, discord, twilio auth token and API key secret, heroku legacy, confluent legacy, bearer) to their Beta.8 profile. Values are synthetic or recomputed from a published checksum over a synthetic body; the profile report is advisory and moves no support status.

title: Beta.8 documented-stable hardening (#209)
description: Synthetic positives, independent controls and single-property twins that bring seven documented-stable families (azure-devops, datadog ddapp_, google AIza, heroku HRKU-, notion secret_, confluent cflt, anthropic sk-ant-api03-) to the documented-24 profile. Values are synthetic or independently constructed (Confluent's checksum from the provider's published algorithm), never provider-issued.

title: Beta.8 AI inference arrival evidence (#208)
description: Arrival evidence for the Replicate, Groq, xAI and OpenRouter inference-key families, none of which has a product detector at the pinned revision: synthetic positives across env, header, SDK, structured-file, prose and tool-output contexts, independent benign controls and one-property twins. Contracts are provisional arrival contracts with per-field provenance (benchmarks/lib/beta8/208.ts); no support status follows from them.

title: Beta.8 · LangSmith and Langfuse arrival evidence
description: Issue #210 arrival fixtures for langsmith:api-key and langfuse:secret-key: synthetic positives across env, header, basic-auth, SDK, container, CI, structured-file and nested observability-metadata contexts, independent public-id/placeholder/reference/prose/near-miss/encoded controls, and one-property negative twins. No product detector targets either family at the pinned revision.

title: Beta.8 developer credential arrival evidence (#211)
description: Arrival fixtures for four developer credential families no registry detector targets: GitHub fine-grained PATs (github_pat_), Slack app-level tokens (xapp-), Stripe webhook signing secrets (whsec_, context-gated) and Notion integration tokens (ntn_). Prefixes are provider-documented; body grammars are community/tool evidence kept provisional. Measures and records; asserts no product support.

title: Beta.8 second-wave arrival evidence (#212)
description: Arrival-profile fixtures for Perplexity, Fireworks AI, Pinecone (current pcsk_ and context-gated legacy UUID keys), Slack user tokens and GitLab runner authentication tokens. These families have no product detector contract of their own; the corpus measures and records, and moves no support status.

title: Beta.8 empirical-route fixture debt (#213, 213d)
description: Synthetic positives on distinct context axes, independent controls and single-property twins that bring seven T2 families (databricks, legacy Datadog application key, mailchimp, mailgun, okta, openai, postman) to the stable-empirical fixture cells, and close the #206 positive/context debt #207 left on atlassian, firebase and supabase. Values are synthetic or independently constructed, never provider-issued; no observation record is implied, and disputed grammar properties (redact-secret#694, #697-#701) are never negative expectations.
